title: Lok Sabha suspends TMC’s Kalyan Banerjee for using ‘unsavoury’ language against women MPs
description: As soon as the House assembled at 2 p.m. after the second adjournment of the day, Krishna Prasad Tenneti, who was chairing the proceedings, referred to a complaint filed by members with the speaker against Mr. Banerjee and said his remarks had hurt the dignity of the House.
